text: I received a National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource (NAIRR) award of GPU credits to investigate an autonomous, LLM-orchestrated pipeline for molecular design and chemical sensing. The project runs 2026–2027.

Our paper "When Memory Hurts: Amplifying Mission-Channel Attacks in LLM-Driven UAV Agents" accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications. Congratulations to the team!

Our paper "When Memory Hurts: Amplifying Mission-Channel Attacks in LLM-Driven UAV Agents" has been accepted at the 25th IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA 2026). Congratulations to the team!
I received support from the "Summer Institute on AI Integration in Cybersecurity Education (Summer 2026)," Washington, D.C. Thanks to George Washington University and the NSF.
Congratulations to Balakrishnan Dharmalingam for successfully received his PhD degree from my team!
